mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS memory_id, r.member_id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname, r.latitude AS latitude, r.longitude AS longitude, r.visited_date AS visited_date, r.nights AS nights, r.content AS content, r.status AS status, COALESCE(rc.report_count, 0) AS report_count, COALESCE(rc.spam_count, 0) AS spam_count, COALESCE(rc.abuse_count, 0) AS abuse_count, COALESCE(rc.illegal_camping_count, 0) AS illegal_camping_count, COALESCE(rc.privacy_count, 0) AS privacy_count, COALESCE(rc.money_scam_count, 0) AS money_scam_count, COALESCE(rc.other_count, 0) AS other_count, r.updated_at AS status_changed_at FROM memory r JOIN member m ON m.id = r.member_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mr.memory_id AS memory_id, COUNT(*) AS report_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN mr.reason = 'SPAM' THEN 1 END) AS spam_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN mr.reason = 'ABUSE' THEN 1 END) AS abuse_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN mr.reason = 'ILLEGAL_CAMPING' THEN 1 END) AS illegal_camping_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN mr.reason = 'PRIVACY' THEN 1 END) AS privacy_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN mr.reason = 'MONEY_SCAM' THEN 1 END) AS money_scam_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN mr.reason = 'OTHER' THEN 1 END) AS other_count FROM memory_report mr WHERE mr.reviewed_at IS NULL GROUP BY mr.memory_id ) rc ON rc.memory_id = r.id WHERE r.status = #{status} AND r.visibility = 'PUBLIC' ORDER BY (COALESCE(rc.money_scam_count, 0) > 0) DESC, r.updated_at ASC, r.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
